fact: The Department of Land and Agriculture deputy registrar says the deeds registry is still substantially manual, with conveyancers lodging documents physically and annual transactions up from about 9,000 to 30,000.

The Vice President and Finance Minister's 2026/27 Budget Speech commits to a four-year programme, starting in 2026/27, to upgrade the Land Information System and strengthen the Integrated Geographic Information System through the Geospatial Information Centre.

The acting Minister of Lands and Agriculture told Parliament the ministry will upgrade the Land Information System and the Integrated Geographic Information System under the Twelfth National Development Plan, and plans an Electronic Deeds Registration Systems Act to give digital registration a legal framework.

Botswana Daily News reports Land Board officers across the country can now process Secure Land Title transactions electronically through the web-based Land Information System, as the Assistant Minister told Parliament on 18 August 2026.
The Assistant Minister of Lands said Land Board officers across the country can process Secure Land Title transactions through the web-based LIS, while only the Gaborone registry can print the deeds.
Botswana's lands minister told Parliament the ministry has an existing Land Information System, a database of land records, and that all residential plots nationwide now have plot numbers.
